name: sql-code-type-case-sensitive-segments
body: sql_code_type matches path segments case-sensitively through has_seg, as cobol_code_type does, so a .sql file under a capitalised Test/, Tests/, Gen/, Obj/ or Vendor/ folder classifies as src. The lowercase segment set covers the planned fixtures (Db/obj/Debug/e.sql). Upgrade when SSDT projects with capitalised folder names appear: add the capitalised names to each segment list, as the csharp arm already does with "Test", "Tests".
